title: SpaceX stock hits new all-time low as AI capex jumps in Q2
excerpt: SpaceX reported second quarter results on Tuesday that topped estimates — its first report as a public company — which comes as the stock has been in a recen...
content_html:
SpaceX (SPCX) reported second quarter results on Tuesday that topped estimates — its first report as a public company — which comes as the stock has been in a recent free fall. Rising capital expenditures in its Q2 report didn't help matters.

SpaceX's AI segment posted an operating loss of $1.26 billion versus estimates of $2.39 billion, but AI spending ballooned to $15.8 billion in the quarter, larger than expected and much higher than the $7.7 billion spent in Q1.

SpaceX stock closed down 13.6% on Wednesday, a new all-time closing low.

The concern with SpaceX's large capital requirements — like those of other large AI frontier startups — is that its AI infrastructure investments will not generate a healthy return given the level of cash required.

"We now project capex of nearly $200B in both 2027 & 2028, which further pressures FCF in 2027, a trend we see across the hyperscalers," JPMorgan analyst Doug Anmuth said in a note to investors. On the flip side, Anmuth was impressed by SpaceX's rising annual revenue run rate (ARR), which CEO Elon Musk said could hit $100 billion by the end of the year.

SpaceX said its Q2 overall capital expenditures came in at $18.37 billion, slightly below estimates for $18.58 billion.

As for the quarter, SpaceX reported Q2 revenue of $7.8 billion versus $6.81 billion, per Bloomberg consensus, up sequentially from $4.7 billion in Q1. SpaceX posted adjusted EBITDA of $3.5 billion vs $2.0 billion consensus expected.

Separately, SpaceX announced on Tuesday that it is partnering with Nvidia to design its Starmind AI-1 payload, which would bring "datacenter class compute" into orbit. The partnership will use Nvidia's Rubin GPUs and Vera CPUs and increase SpaceX's peak satellite computing capacity to 250 kW.

Musk added on the earnings call that Nvidia would be the exclusive supplier of chips for SpaceX's AI chip needs.

With its Q2 results behind it, a big overhang still looms.

"[On Tuesday afternoon] SpaceX🚀 (SPCX: NASDAQ) reports as a public company for the first time, and two days later, Aug. 6, its lockup frees hundreds of millions of insider shares — roughly triple the current tradable float," Epistrophy Capital's Cory Johnson wrote in a client note.

The lockup expiration will free up to 20% of shares for sale, and investors are worried that the added supply will keep the stock under pressure.

Read more: SpaceX stock keeps sliding. What to do if you own shares.

Another part of the capital expenditures story is the company's satellite broadband service, Starlink, and what's next for the launch business with Starship.

content_html_zh:
SpaceX (SPCX) 周二公布的第二季度业绩超出了预期，这是该公司作为上市公司的第一份报告，而该公司股价最近一直在暴跌。 第二季度报告中资本支出的增加无济于事。

SpaceX 的 AI 部门公布运营亏损 12.6 亿美元，而预期为 23.9 亿美元，但本季度 AI 支出激增至 158 亿美元，高于预期，远高于第一季度的 77 亿美元支出。

SpaceX 股价周三收盘下跌 13.6%，创下历史收盘新低。

与其他大型人工智能前沿初创公司一样，SpaceX 的巨额资本要求令人担忧的是，考虑到所需的现金水平，其人工智能基础设施投资将无法产生健康的回报。

摩根大通分析师 Doug Anmuth 在给投资者的一份报告中表示：“我们现在预计 2027 年和 2028 年的资本支出将接近 200B 美元，这将进一步给 2027 年的自由现金流带来压力，这是我们在超大规模企业中看到的趋势。” 另一方面，安姆斯对 SpaceX 不断上升的年收入运行率（ARR）印象深刻，首席执行官埃隆·马斯克表示，到今年年底，该收入可能会达到 1000 亿美元。

SpaceX 表示，第二季度总体资本支出为 183.7 亿美元，略低于预期的 185.8 亿美元。

至于本季度，SpaceX 报告第二季度收入为 78 亿美元，彭博社一致认为，第二季度收入为 68.1 亿美元，比第一季度的 47 亿美元有所增长。 SpaceX 公布的调整后 EBITDA 为 35 亿美元，而市场普遍预期为 20 亿美元。

另外，SpaceX 周二宣布，它正在与 Nvidia 合作设计其 Starmind AI-1 有效载荷，该有效载荷将把“数据中心级计算”带入轨道。 此次合作将使用 Nvidia 的 Rubin GPU 和 Vera CPU，并将 SpaceX 的峰值卫星计算能力提高到 250 kW。

马斯克在财报电话会议上补充说，英伟达将成为 SpaceX 人工智能芯片需求的独家芯片供应商。

尽管第二季度业绩已经落后，但仍存在巨大的悬念。

“[周二下午]SpaceX🚀（SPCX：纳斯达克）首次作为一家上市公司报告，两天后，即 8 月 6 日，其禁售释放了数亿股内部股票——大约是目前可交易流通股的三倍，”Epi​​stropy Capital 的 Cory Johnson 在一份客户报告中写道。

禁售期满后，最多将有 20% 的股票可供出售，投资者担心增加的供应量将使该股承受压力。

了解更多：SpaceX 股价持续下滑。 如果您拥有股票该怎么办。

资本支出故事的另一部分是该公司的卫星宽带服务 Starlink，以及 Starship 发射业务的下一步。
